uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of Token Tooltips on this device. "Like Foundry" follows Foundry's language.

theme.name: Look
theme.hint: Signature shows the tooltips on warm paper, Foundry keeps them dark like the rest of Foundry.

enabled.name: Show tooltips
enabled.hint: Tooltips appear when you rest the pointer on a token. Off: no tooltips on this device.

delay.name: Delay (milliseconds)
delay.hint: How long the pointer rests on a token before its tooltip appears.

position.name: Position
position.hint: Where the tooltip appears next to the token. It moves to the other side when there is no room.

size.name: Size
size.hint: Text size of the tooltips on this device.

respectNames.name: Follow the name display of each token
respectNames.hint: Players only see a token's name in the tooltip when the token shows its name to everyone on hover or always. Off: the name follows the field settings alone.

Keys.showAllHint: While the key is held, every visible token shows its tooltip.

Fields.title: Tooltip fields
Fields.menuHint: Choose the values the tooltips show, their order and who sees them, exact or only described. Add your own values from a data path.
Fields.heading: What the tooltips show
Fields.intro: Fields of the {preset} preset for {system}. Owners, observers and the GM see every field meant for them exactly. For everyone else you choose per token disposition, with a column of its own for the other players' characters.
Fields.customHint: Pick a common value or any value of the selected token, or type a path into the actor's data. Start it with token. to read the token instead. Resource and count need an object with value and max.
Fields.previewHint: Select a token on the scene to see it here.
Fields.invalidCustom: The field needs a label and a data path of letters, digits, dots and underscores.
Fields.resetConfirm: Reset every field of this system to its default and remove your own fields? Nothing changes until you save.

Picker.openHint: Pick a value from the common values of this system or from all values of the selected token
Picker.search: Search by name, path or value
Picker.noToken: Select a token on the scene to see all its values here.
Picker.noCommon: This system has no list of common values. All values lists every value of the selected token.
Picker.more: {count} more values. Search to narrow the list.
Picker.notFound: {name} has no value at this path.
Picker.noFit: Value at {name}: {value}. As {format} the tooltip shows nothing for it.
Picker.noPreviewToken: Select a token to see its value here.

SELFTEST.Title: Token Tooltips self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks the parts of Foundry the tooltips use, reads every field from a token of the viewed scene and draws a test tooltip. The result appears as a whisper in the chat.
SELFTEST.Hover: Foundry's hover handling of tokens was not found.
SELFTEST.Canvas: Foundry's conversion from the map to the screen was not found.
SELFTEST.Constants: Foundry's token dispositions or name display modes were not found.
SELFTEST.Generic: {system} has no preset of its own, the tooltips show the token bars and effects. Add more values as your own fields.
SELFTEST.Read: These fields could not be read from {token}: {fields}
SELFTEST.Draw: The test tooltip for {token} could not be drawn.
SELFTEST.NoToken: There is no token on the viewed scene, so no field was read. Open a scene with tokens and run the test again.
SELFTEST.Disabled: Tooltips are switched off in the settings of this device.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Token Tooltips was verified with older versions ({versions} is newer). Run the self test in the module settings to check it.

DEBUG.Title: Debug file
DEBUG.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
DEBUG.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
